proposed.text: A site plan is drawn at 1:500 scale. The property is 50 m wide and 80 m deep. On the drawing, what will be the dimensions of the property boundary rectangle in millimeters?
proposed.rationale: At 1:500 scale, 1 unit on the drawing represents 500 units in reality. Property width: 50 m ÷ 500 = 0.1 m = 100 mm. Depth: 80 m ÷ 500 = 0.16 m = 160 mm. [A]: Correct. You calculated the scale reduction accurately. [B]: Incorrect. This is 1:1000 scale division, not 1:500. [C]: Incorrect. This is oversized; it would correspond to 1:100 scale. [D]: Incorrect. This is far too small; it corresponds to 1:10,000 scale.
